plan.purpose: Separate waveform accuracy from local material sensitivity and real physical descent after width8 passed narrow waveform screens
plan.scope: Existing training000 geometry, source0, contrast axis only; diagnostic development states, not full-pixel Jacobian or blind FWI
plan.training: None; all networks, scales, base and train-only reference coefficients frozen
plan.waveform_response: Full2000-step scattered receiver central differences along support contrast a. Requested absolute epsilon0.001 and0.0005. Record actual float32 proxy contrasts and use the identical positive endpoints for promoted-float64 FD differences
plan.reference: Same discrete stencil with original coefficients promoted to float64, source0 and fixed support. FD double arithmetic is a numerical derivative reference, not independent physics
plan.metrics: Pooled and individual directional response relativeL2, predicted/reference norm ratio, waveform-response cosine, two-epsilon convergence; report each state separately
plan.loss_gradient: Correct source0 time cost against frozen training a=0.5 full traces, multiplied by1e12. Compare scalar AD derivative to proxy finite differences and physical AD derivative. Scalar sign is informative, scalar gradient cosine is not a high-dimensional angle
plan.precision_checks: Promote the frozen float32 target to FD float64 without recomputing its labels; use identical objective, sampling and actual contrasts. Record float32 proxy finite-difference limits, do not call unreliable difference an accurate derivative
plan.true_step_trials: At each state use candidate a-step*sign(proxy loss derivative), steps0.02 and0.01, bounded to[0.3,0.7]. Recompute physical float64 cost against the same frozen target; report actual step, cost ratio and contrast distance to0.5 for every method/step, no selected best trial
plan.selection: All predefined states, methods, epsilons and step trials reported; no checkpoint selection, optimization, test-based tuning or new geometry generation
plan.screening: Directional response relative error<=20% and waveform-response cosine>=0.9 are project screens, not guarantees. Genuine physical descent must be reported independently; an accepted scalar step does not prove full FWI recovery
plan.decision: If waveform accuracy is adequate but sensitivity is poor, define one derivative-informed correction in a separate protocol. If both responses and physical steps are useful, evaluate a small further contrast/geometry protocol while retaining the simple reference. Do not claim innovation or acceleration over linear interpolation from these checks

execution_details.objective_accumulation: float64 for all methods, including after float32 proxy output; background added after promotion
execution_details.numerical_qa: Report both epsilon results; do not retune original 20% / 0.9 response screens
execution_details.resource_cap: No training, two physical AD evaluations, twelve proxy endpoint evaluations plus six scalar AD evaluations; physical steps cached; stop on OOM
execution_details.zero_response_baseline: Relative response error 1, norm ratio 0, cosine undefined; constant predictor loss gradient zero
